value.statement: 1,592 of the 4,776 people in the gallery have no usable reference face (1,430 have no Commons reference at all): for them verify can only answer 'no usable reference'. That is a ceiling on coverage, apart from the threshold. In calibration, a name that resolves only to such a person is unscorable, as is one that resolves to several people (verify refuses it): it counts as a rejection against TAR (cost_in_true_accepts; tar_scorable leaves it out), as coverage when a person confirms it (review_findings), and never as a true or a false accept.
